context: Two teens chat about a stubborn dad on the walk home
purpose: Teach: スゴイ/おやじ/黄色い/ちっとも/敢えて/まもなく/咲く/辿り

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ聞いてよ、うちのおやじちっとも話聞いてくれないんだけど。
lines.en: Hey listen, my dad doesn't listen to me at all.
lines.style: Teen girl venting with exasperated and casual tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる、頑固おやじってどこも一緒だよな。
lines.en: I get it, stubborn dads are the same everywhere.
lines.style: Teen boy commiserating in a relaxed familiar way

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日なんてさ、敢えて言うけど、優しく頼んだのに無視されたんだよ。
lines.en: Yesterday, I'll just say it, I asked nicely and got ignored.
lines.style: Teen girl recounting frustration with rising indignation

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、それはスゴイ塩対応だな。昨日のこと辿り直させて謝らせろよ。
lines.en: Whoa, that's seriously cold. Make him go back over yesterday and apologize.
lines.style: Teen boy joking with mock outrage and casual slang

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、見て、あそこの黄色い花、もう咲くんだね。
lines.en: Oh look, those yellow flowers are already blooming.
lines.style: Teen girl shifting topic with soft cheerful curiosity

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとだ、まもなく春が来るって感じだな。
lines.en: You're right, it really feels like spring is almost here.
lines.style: Teen boy responding warmly and a bit reflective

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、ま、おやじのことも花が咲くころには許してあげるかも。
lines.en: Yeah, maybe I'll forgive my dad by the time flowers bloom.
lines.style: Teen girl softening with a playful resigned smile

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おっ、急にスゴイ大人っぽいじゃん。
lines.en: Whoa, suddenly you sound super grown-up.
lines.style: Teen boy teasing affectionately with light laughter
